name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: A mutual NDA that lets two parties disclose confidential information to each other in connection with a stated purpose, with standard use, protection, and return/destruction obligations.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: A framework agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering access and use, support, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: An agreement giving an early customer access to a product in exchange for structured feedback and participation in a provider's design partner program.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: An SLA meant to be used alongside the Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement, defining uptime and support response time targets, how they are calculated, and service credit remedies.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: A framework agreement for engaging professional services under one or more statements of work, covering deliverables, IP assignment, payment, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: A DPA governing a provider's processing of personal data on behalf of a customer, including subprocessors, international data transfers (EEA SCCs and UK Addendum), security incident response, and audit rights.

name: Software License Agreement
description: An on-premise/installed software license agreement covering license grant, restrictions, updates, open source components, warranties, liability, and termination.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: A flexible agreement for business partnerships involving mutual obligations, optional fees, and a trademark license for co-marketing activities.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: A HIPAA BAA governing a business associate's use and disclosure of protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity, including safeguards, breach notification, and subcontractor requirements.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: A short-term trial or evaluation agreement that lets a prospective customer test a product before committing to a longer-term commercial agreement.

name: AI Addendum
description: An addendum supplementing a commercial agreement to govern the use of AI/ML features, including input/output ownership, model training restrictions, and AI-specific disclaimers.
